narrative.northStar: Introduce Navodhai and make it straightforward to start an enquiry from one fast page.
narrative.overview: The visual authority is the user's Canva **Digital Brand & Website Guidelines 1.0 — V4 Companion**, design `DAHaQEXgEaY`. Its ten pages were read on 14 November 2026. See `docs/branding/canva-brand-adaptation.md` for source pages and asset provenance. This supersedes the provisional white/aubergine/orchid system; the requested brand takes precedence over earlier anti-template palette/font preferences. Current source is `src/`, built through Vite+ into static `dist/`.
keyCharacteristics: The centred brand lockup sits above the hero, with one borderless sun/moon icon button on the right. When the header container is at most 16rem wide, including when the visitor enlarges text, the identity gets the full first row and the theme control sits at the right of a second row. The monogram and name can also wrap within their link if needed. This header stays in normal page flow and scrolls away. The floating bar, compact identity state, frame, blur and docking listeners were removed after the user rejected the strip over the content. There is no replacement overlay. The separate floating back-to-top icon remains at the lower edge of the page.

The hero uses the approved editorial option A: the two-line **Be a princess.** headline at the left, the transparent textile illustration in the centre, and garment choices with a WhatsApp action at the right. The quieter service description **Blouse & dress making.** and confirmed locality sit beneath the tagline; the former introductory paragraph is removed. Content is capped at 1248px. When the opening container is at most 60rem wide, the reading order becomes centred tagline/service/locality, illustration, then enquiry. At 33.75rem the headline and controls use their phone sizes. These rem-based container thresholds also adapt to enlarged text rather than squeezing the three columns. Tablet/phone garment choices wrap into additional rows when their labels need room. The artwork stays fully visible at 4:3, without a rectangular background.

Made around your idea follows as a supporting-surface band. Its left column introduces the confirmed services in Coimbatore; its right column describes blouse making, dress making and customisation, separated by two fine rules. Each description retains its decorative 88px studio-object illustration (56px on phones). The next canvas section, Start with a conversation, explains three online-enquiry steps in a semantic ordered list: share an idea, discuss requirements/measurements, and agree on the next step. A two-column composition stacks at 760px. Visits in Coimbatore are optional and arranged as needed. These sections have no duplicate selector, message preview or enquiry button. The removed preparation/FAQ is not restored. Conceptual illustrations never stand in for real work photographs.

rules.name: Identity and colour
rules.body: Use the five exact V4 colours above. Muted, surface and rule are derived interface neutrals, not additional identity colours. The light opening and page use Ivory with Plum headings, Charcoal body text and Plum actions. The dark page uses canvas `#261A24`, surface `#392732`, Ivory text, muted text `#DBC4C4`, rules `#806373` and Ivory actions with Plum text. The contact close stays Royal Plum with Ivory content in both appearances. Dusty Rose belongs to the textile material. Antique Gold is a controlled detail and focus colour on dark surfaces, never body text or a focus boundary on ivory.

rules.name: Motion and assets
rules.body:
The header and hero share one decorative pointer-following light behind their content. One canvas spans the page top through the bottom of the hero, preserving the banner and main landmarks. A broad ellipse tracks the actual mouse position continuously across both areas, with a damped spring (stiffness 170, damping 30, mass 0.6); opacity uses stiffness 250, damping 35, mass 0.5. Entry places it directly at the pointer before fading in; movement then follows with a soft lag. This replaces the research study's barely visible 24px centre offset, making the tracking apparent. The wash is clamp(20rem, 52cqi, 46rem) wide at a 3:2 ratio. Its gradient uses core colour at 0%, edge colour at 38%, and transparency by 72%. Light appearance uses 18% Rose / 7% Gold; dark appearance uses 15% Gold / 6% Rose. These are alpha treatments of the existing palette, not extra brand colours. Text, artwork and controls stay in their normal positions; only the clipped, noninteractive background layer moves. It uses Motion spring values rather than React state per pointer event. There is no idle animation loop or permanent will-change. The light fades when the pointer leaves the combined header/hero area or on native scrolling, and resets on resize, blur, page hiding, offscreen exit and input/preference changes. Touch/coarse input, reduced motion, forced colours, missing JavaScript and the prerendered state retain the plain canvas. It never captures clicks, changes the native cursor or intercepts scrolling.

Explicit appearance changes use a 220ms whole-page crossfade through the native View Transition API where available, with 180ms opacity and 260ms rotation/scale transitions for the sun/moon icon. The initial theme applies directly before painting. Reduced motion skips the native transition and disables the icon transitions. Browsers without the API still switch correctly with local icon feedback. The user approved a subtle entrance specifically for the hero tagline: its two intact lines settle upward by 4px, from 94% to full opacity over 650ms, with a 90ms offset on the second line and a decelerating cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). CSS starts it once per page load without a hydration trigger; the words remain readable throughout. It does not loop or replay when garment/theme state changes, and reduced motion leaves the tagline fully static. The brand header, body, enquiry layout and theme icon remain visible and steady from the initial HTML. Content never waits for scrolling to become visible. Hero motion retains the 320ms small artwork rotation/translation, 180ms button feedback and 360ms seam drawing. The editorial illustrations are static, lazy-loaded 192px WebP assets with preserved alpha; their sources and exact built-in image_gen prompts are in `docs/branding/idea-illustrations/`. Nothing loops or hides essential copy. Reduced-motion preferences suppress these movements and smooth scrolling; native scrolling and all contact links remain usable. Browser favicons use tightly cropped 96px single-ink artwork on Ivory or Royal Plum, with a multi-size ICO fallback. Apple and Android bookmark icons use the original gold/rose mark on Ivory; the maskable icon keeps the central safe zone clear. The existing 1200 by 630 social card retains the approved tagline, services, locality and conceptual textile study.

dos: Preserve verified V4 artwork, palette and companion fonts.
Identify the hero artwork as conceptual through its alternative text.
Keep content and direct contact routes usable before hydration.
Honor saved appearance and reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Do not retype, recolour or distort the logo.
Do not restore the removed enquiry widget, message preview or preparation disclosures.
Do not add a floating header or session entrance animation.
Do not present generated material studies as actual commissions.
